messages:
sam (partnerships): Following up from the partner call with IdentityBridge — they want a joint marketplace launch + ops integration. Main scope: SAML SSO (SP-initiated + IdP-initiated), SCIM provisioning (delta + bulk import), secrets sync via KMS/HSM key-wrap, and webhook/audit forwarding. Can we map owners and blocker list?

olivia (product): I'll own the product checklist and install UX copy. Need to know supported provisioning modes (delta vs full), whether they support scim:bulk, and what attributes they require. Also: do they support SCIM PATCH?

identityflow-ps: We support SCIM PATCH and full bulk imports (CSV -> bulk SCIM). Attributes: userName, emails, displayName, externalId. Groups supported. We can provide a sandbox with 10k users for a stress test.

ajay (security): I'll take HSM/KMS integration and webhook signing audit trail. Ask them for: HSM vendor name, attestation cert, key-wrap API spec (wrap/unwrap endpoints), TLS certs, and a read-only test key that can be used for a wrap operation. Also want to verify their KMS supports RSA-OAEP or AES-GCM wrapping.

derek (eng): I'll take SAML and runtime integration. Need their IdP metadata, sample SAML responses, and a list of ACS URLs they expect. We should also confirm they enforce audience restriction and exact NameID format. I'll add an automated smoke check to our install script: validate SAML signature and ACS roundtrip.

marta (compliance): I need their SOC2 or ISO attestation, data residency commitments (EU/US), and retention policies for logs and audit. Also confirm whether secrets synced to us are stored encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys or partner-managed keys.

sam (partnerships): Great. Two commercial bits: 1) marketplace pricing tier (self-serve vs enterprise managed) so we can surface it in the listing; 2) lead-gen integration (form vs SSO-install flow) — what do we want for initial launch?

identityflow-ps: Pricing: they prefer a free install tier for devs, plus enterprise onboarding with a managed key option. They can provide a lead webhook for enterprise leads. Embargo for joint announcement: May 15 09:00 PT.

olivia (product): For the marketplace install flow, let's support: Quick Connect (token-based), and an Enterprise Connect (assisted onboarding). Sam, can you confirm marketplace metadata fields we need?

sam (partnerships): I'll draft the marketplace metadata fields. Off the top: blurb (short/long), integration tags (SAML, SCIM, KMS, HSM), screenshots (1x install, 1x admin panel), logo (SVG + PNG), contact URL, lead webhook URL, pricing plan names.

ajay (security): Technical test snippet for partner to run so we can validate key-wrap behavior. Ask them to run this against their sandbox wrap endpoint and paste the output (base64):

```
curl -X POST https://kms-sandbox.identitybridge.com/wrap 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap-key","plaintext":"VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3Q="}'
```

We will verify wrappedKey length and that unwrap returns the original plaintext.

derek (eng): SCIM test I'll use: example PATCH to add user to group:

PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{ "Operations": [ { "op": "Add", "value": { "members": [ { "value": "jdoe" } ] } } ] }

Please include sample error responses for rate limits and 429 behavior.

identityflow-ps: Will provide sandbox endpoints, attestation PDF, SAML metadata, and SCIM error codes by EOD Wednesday. We'll also expose a read-only wrap key for the test.

marta (compliance): One more: data processing agreement (DPA) and any cross-border transfer clauses. IdentityBridge legal should send a draft DPA and marketing approval window.

sam (partnerships): Action items summary:
- IdentityBridge -> send SAML metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, HSM attestation, DPA draft, logo + brand kit by Wed EOD.
- ajay -> schedule 30min threat-model call once attestation is received (target Thu).
- derek -> add SAML + SCIM tests to partner-integration CI (toggleable).
- olivia -> draft marketplace short + long blurb and screenshot request.
- marta -> checklist for DPA + retention + residency.

release-bot: created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/519 — includes placeholder listing and install flow stub.

derek (eng): Quick note about runtime secrets sync: we should decide whether to perform key-wrap at partner side (partner wraps secrets with their HSM and we store the wrapped blob) or we perform wrap by calling partner's KMS directly on demand. Preference: partner-wrapped blobs so we never hold the plaintext and partner rotates keys independently. Thoughts?

ajay (security): Partner-wrapped is safer for least-privilege. But we need clear TTL and unwrap protocols for disaster recovery. Also ensure we have an audit endpoint (webhook or log forward) that notifies unwrap events.

identityflow-ps: We prefer partner-wrapped blobs. We can provide an unwrap API for authorized calls and an event stream for unwraps. We'll include RBAC scopes for unwrap.

olivia (product): UX implication: admin needs an "Unwrap history" view and a way to configure key rotation sync. Add to docs checklist.

sam (partnerships): Timeline proposal: Wed (artifact delivery), Thu (security call), next Mon internal dry-run, May 10 internal partner install, May 15 embargo lift. Anyone foresee major blockers?

marta (compliance): Need to review DPA and attestation before dry-run. If DPA edits run long, could push to May 12. Keep me in the loop.

sam (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll loop in partner legal and schedule the threat-model call once ajay confirms time. Ping here for any updates.
